Friendzy / Classic party games / The Roast Battle

How to play The Roast Battle

Funny burns only. No cruelty. One person volunteers to be roasted. The group takes turns delivering funny, affectionate observations. The roastee scores each burn on a 1-5 scale. Highest total wins the roast.

3–10 players~10 minBold & WarmSocial & discussion games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. One player volunteers to be roasted.
  2. Going around, each player delivers one roast joke or observation.
  3. Jokes must be funny, not mean-spirited. Personal attacks are not the same as roast jokes.
  4. The roastee scores each burn from 1 (weak) to 5 (deserved a standing ovation).
  5. Highest total score wins. Then a new person volunteers for the seat.

Example round

  • 'You're the type of person who sets three alarms and still asks what time it is.'
  • 'Your vibe is 'just shipped something to the wrong address but confidently.'
  • 'You're the only person I know whose 'five-minute shower' is a historical fiction.'

Tips

  • Great roasts are specific, accurate, and delivered warmly. Generic insults don't land.
  • The roastee laughing is the highest compliment — that's a 5.
